entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Labuan Bajo is a diocese of the Latin Church of the Catholic Church, located in the Lesser Sunda Islands, Indonesia. The diocese was split from Roman Catholic Diocese of Ruteng and was established on 21 June 2024. Its cathedral episcopal see is the Cathedral of The Holy Spirit in Labuan Bajo.
